items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-04
items.q: And he had Robert. They called him Bob. He plays around here. ... You know Bob.

ctx.x: A little Wesley Dimes. He's dead now. He got killed. And he had Robert. They called him Bob. He plays around here. He plays on the, he's kind of sick now. He waits down here at the first precinct. You know Bob. He played trombone. So he recorded with, uh... Bob Thomas? Yeah. He recorded with Bob Ryan. He recorded with several orchestra friends. Yeah. But he was playing trombone at the time.
And is he from Baton Rouge or something? I think Bob is from Baton Rouge. He's out in California now, you know. Is he? Yeah.
